description:
Check whether a guest can book a WEE WiLDS unit for these dates.

    Applies everything the booking system does: nights already booked, minimum
    and maximum stays, arrival and departure days, and how far ahead each unit
    opens (B&B rooms 100 days before arrival, pods 365).

    Args:
        unit: One of "muckle-meadow-pod", "cosie-coorie-pod", "bb".
              The "bb" slug returns per-room results for all 4 B&B rooms.
        check_in: Arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must not be in the past.
        check_out: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after check_in.

    Returns:
        For pods: {available, verdict, reason, shortest_bookable_nights?, opens_on?, ...}.
        For "bb": {rooms: [{room, available, verdict, reason, ...}], any_room_available, ...}.
        available is true (bookable), false (see reason, e.g. a 5-night minimum,
        with shortest_bookable_nights to suggest instead) or null (could not be
        confirmed: send the guest to the booking page). On invalid input: {error}.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be in the past.
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after check_in.
check_out.title: Check Out

unit.description: Which WEE WiLDS unit: "muckle-meadow-pod" (Muckle Meadow Glamping Pod), "cosie-coorie-pod" (Cosy Coorie Pod) or "bb" (the B&B, all 4 rooms).
unit.title: Unit

name: get_availability

RoomAvailability.description: One B&B room. Fields mean the same as the top-level stay fields.

outputSchema.description: For a pod the stay fields are top level; for "bb" they are per room in `rooms`.

any_room_available.description: "bb" only: true if any room is bookable, null if a room could not be confirmed and none is bookable.

availability_source.description: "hub" (full check), or "hub-booked-nights-only" / "ical-booked-nights-only" when stay rules could not be checked.

available.description: true: bookable as asked. false: not bookable, see reason. null: could not be confirmed just now, send the guest to the booking page.

book_url.description: Booking page with these dates already selected and the live total shown; give it to the guest to reserve and pay. Absent when the stay cannot be booked.

checked_at.description: When this was checked, ISO 8601 UTC.

data_warning.description: Set when the full check could not run.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be answered; says why.

min_nights_from_arrival.description: Minimum stay for this arrival date today. Minimums relax as the date gets closer.

next_step.description: What to do next: pricing and booking link.

nights_booked.description: Nights in the stay that are already booked, YYYY-MM-DD.

opens_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD the dates open for booking (verdict not_open_yet).

reason.description: Plain-English reason, ready to tell the guest.

shortest_bookable_nights.description: Shortest stay that can be booked from this arrival date; suggest it when the asked stay is too short.

url.description: Unit page with the live booking calendar.

valid_units.description: Valid unit slugs, on an unknown unit.

verdict.description: Machine-readable reason: bookable, booked, blocked, not_open_yet, departs_after_window, too_soon, in_the_past, min_stay, max_stay, arrival_not_allowed, departure_not_allowed, rules_unavailable, no_rules or unknown.

title: Check availability
